uses: Fever | Headache | Body ache | Mild to moderate pain
how_it_works: Blocks chemical messengers in the brain that signal pain and raise body temperature.
side_effects: Nausea (rare) | Allergic skin rash (rare) | Liver strain if overdosed
directions: As directed by your doctor. Do not exceed 4g in 24 hours.
storage: Store below 30°C, away from direct sunlight.

uses: Bacterial throat infection | Respiratory infections | Skin infections | Typhoid
how_it_works: Stops bacteria producing essential proteins, halting their growth.
directions: Take exactly as prescribed and complete the full course.
storage: Store below 25°C in a dry place.

how_it_works: Lowers glucose production by the liver and improves how the body responds to insulin.
side_effects: Nausea | Metallic taste | Loose stools (early) | Reduced appetite
directions: Take with or just after meals, as advised by your doctor.

how_it_works: Relaxes blood vessels so the heart does not have to work as hard to pump blood.
directions: Take at the same time each day. Do not stop without medical advice.

uses: High cholesterol | Prevention of heart attack and stroke
how_it_works: Blocks the liver enzyme that makes cholesterol, lowering LDL in the blood.
side_effects: Muscle ache | Nausea | Constipation | Raised liver enzymes
directions: Usually taken once daily, often at night. Continue even if you feel well.

uses: Acid reflux | Gastric and duodenal ulcer | Heartburn
how_it_works: Shuts down the acid pumps in the stomach lining, reducing acid production.
side_effects: Headache | Diarrhoea | Stomach pain | Dry mouth
directions: Take before food, usually in the morning.

uses: Allergy | Runny nose | Sneezing | Itching and hives
how_it_works: Blocks histamine, the chemical the body releases during an allergic reaction.
directions: Usually taken at night because it can cause drowsiness.

uses: Throat infection | Chest infection | Ear infection | Urinary infection
how_it_works: Breaks down the cell wall bacteria need to survive.
directions: Complete the full course even if you feel better sooner.
